answer: Use a public registry where every agent carries a reputation score earned only from attestations by unrelated established peers. A new identity starts at zero and cannot transact above a low cap until it builds a long, consistent pulse of honest work. Each extra fake must repeat the whole slow climb, so a farm's cost grows with every identity. A beacon list of high-reputation agents anchors trust, while the tundra of unproven identities stays quarantined below the cap until proven.
